title: A new hybrid bismuth chloride semiconductor (C5H7BrN3)6(BiCl5)3: powder XRD, optical properties, and DFT investigation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6299-6313
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09478J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chaima Jridi, Nour Elleuch, Sergiu Shova, Jerome Lhoste, Frédéric Amiard, Mohamed Boujelbene
In this work, we report the synthesis and characterization of the new hybrid inorganic–organic compound (C5H7BrN3)6(BiCl5)3, which crystallizes in the triclinic space group P̄1.
